purpose: Validate a variational projected tensor-AQUAL solver and the structural limits of a single galaxy-plus-cluster constitutive law before any kinematic or raw-lensing target is opened.
equation: div[mu(|grad Phi|/a0) ((1-sigma) I + sigma n_hat n_hat) grad Phi] = 4 pi G rho_b, where n_hat is perpendicular to the baryonic transport direction h_hat

definitions.ell: |g_N|/||grad g_N||_F with the inherited numerical trace bounds
definitions.h_hat: unit gas-minus-star component-field direction, falling back to the traced Newtonian direction where the difference vanishes
definitions.n_hat: the in-plane direction perpendicular to h_hat

solver.discretization: symmetric variational graph: Cartesian isotropic links for mu(1-sigma) plus bilinear plus/minus n_hat links for mu sigma

claim_boundary: P0659 tests mathematical structure and numerical machinery only; it cannot establish galaxy or lensing accuracy.
The projected graph is a two-dimensional variational discretization of the tensor equation; a three-dimensional and covariant completion remains required.
The Solar quantity is a constitutive anisotropy proxy, not a derived PPN gamma or Mercury prediction.
The 10 kpc coherence length is inherited from P0643 and remains phenomenological even though no new constant is added here.
No P0633 galaxy velocity, P0640 lens constraint, or spent lens residual may be used in solver development or selection.
